title: Ship AI booking form now or after Web Bot Auth verification

state.goal: AI search finds a Zenno business and books it directly in the chat. Founder wants to launch and sell fast.
state.ready: Get-found structured data + llms.txt on every shop page, the no-JavaScript AI booking form with a JSON version, and keyless booking with explicit customer confirmation, Jev intent check, per-business cap (30/hour) and per-client cap (10/hour), audit log, merchant and customer emails. 62 automated tests pass.
state.missing: Web Bot Auth signature verification (proving a request really comes from ChatGPT/Google). Today the merchant sees a label guessed from the user agent (e.g. 'ChatGPT'), which is never used for access. Verified agents would get higher limits and a trusted label. Estimated extra work: about half a day, cryptographic signature checking.
state.risk_without_it: Everyone gets the same conservative limits; labels could be faked but grant nothing.

release_timing.instructions: Should Zenno release the AI booking form now, or wait until Web Bot Auth verification is built?

criteria.release_now_verify_next: Release now; build verification right after as an upgrade.
criteria.wait_for_verification: Hold the release until verification is built.
